brief.change: Q2 2026 prints admitted for Carvana, Hertz and Charter; Spirit's evidence is 118 days old.
brief.impact: Carvana compressed to 1.2x net leverage; Charter holds its 4.0x–4.5x band on its own definition, 4.6x on the house standard.
brief.action: Compare Carvana against Charter on LTM Q2-26 · BASE · accepted only; read Hertz apart while CP-3C is restricted.
brief.evidence: One accepted snapshot pinned per credit, each named · 24 passports · 1 deviation · 1 stale.
brief.headline: 2 COMPARED

verdict.conclusion: Carvana and Charter compared on one stated basis; Charter's leverage deviates from the house definition by 0.2x — marked, not hidden.
